critique: Both captured screenshots are frozen on the 'COMPONENT SEVERED!' modal selection screen, hiding active gameplay.
The top-left 'CORE INTEGRITY' HUD text is dark teal on dark blue, making it almost illegible.
Particle explosions drift directly behind the translucent modal popup and buttons, creating visual noise behind text.
Color coding on the directive buttons (cyan, gold, orange) is punchy and keyboard shortcuts [1], [2], [3] are clearly labeled.
priorityFixes: Increase contrast on the Core Integrity HUD frame and text by using bright white or cyan text.
Add a semi-opaque dark backdrop blur to the salvage modal so background particles do not clash with button text.
Scale down or offset the salvage pop-up so the combat arena and player ship remain clearly visible during choices.
